Privacy starts on your device

Your conversations.
Your data.
Your control.

Important conversations deserve a private place. In local mode, your audio and transcription are processed on your own device. You choose what stays and what you share.

Work locally, independently

Record and transcribe on your device after setup. No Pichi account and no per-minute cloud transcription fees in local mode.

Keep control of your recordings

Choose whether to keep audio and what to share. Store recordings and text on your device, and decide where to send them.

Share only what you intend

Protected text export helps hide sensitive passages. Review the result and choose what to share. Cloud features are yours to opt into.

A few answers

Good to know.
Easy to start.

Does it work without internet?

Yes. After the initial setup, record conversations and turn speech into text without an internet connection.

Do I need an account or pay by the minute?

Local recording and transcription need no Pichi account. Use them without paying for cloud transcription by the minute.

What conversations can I save?

Work calls, interviews, discussions and in-person meetings. Return to the moments that matter and share the parts you choose.

What if I want to use a cloud service?

Connect a service you want and choose what to send. Cloud services have their own data policies and fees.
